## Houston 1.0.18

### What's new

- Conversations started for your AI employees through the Houston API or MCP, for example from Codex, now show on the board, so you can follow and continue them.
- Long conversations respond faster.
- AI employees with many files get to work faster.
- Stability and performance improvements.

### Before you upgrade

- Quit Houston before installing. macOS doesn't always replace a running app. If in doubt, delete Houston from Applications and drag the new copy in.
